actionLambda.description:
The action that is retried based on the specs provided. This is a private variable. Do NOT populate this field
manually; use {@see #action} below populate this field. The {@see #action} also fills the default values that the
user may not otherwise provide. See usage above.

context.description: The context of this retry logic

onSuccess.description:
Call to specify a function that should be called on successful invocation of the action. By default success will
simply complete retry logic. However this callback can use {@link #setShouldRetry(boolean)} or
{@link #setException()} to change this behavior.

onError.description:
Call to specify a function that should be called when exception was encountered running the action. Retryable
exceptions will be automatically retried and an error will be thrown for any non-retryable exceptions encountered.
However this callback can use {@link #setShouldRetry(boolean)} or {@link #setException()} to change this behavior.

beforeRetry.description:
Call to specify a function to perform custom cleanup between tries if the action needs to be retried.

Callback will be called before sleeping and only in between of tries.

nextSleepMillis.description:
Call to specify a function to determine the sleep time between retry operations. If not specified, a default
exponential backoff algorithm will be used instead.

description.description:
Call to specify a function that should be called to provide a description to put in the log message when the
operation needs to be retried

wrapError.description:
Callback function that produces a custom error when overall operation fails (due to either non-retryable error to
timeout or exceeding maxTries).

retryAllErrors.description: A flag to retry the action upon any error

maxRetries.description:
the maximum number of times the action will be retried. This means that it will run at most 1 + maxRetries
times including the initial attempt.

initSleepMillis.description: the value of the initial number of milliseconds to sleep before the first retry (not first call).

maxSleepMillis.description: the value of the maximum number of milliseconds to sleep before the next retry.

maxTotalMillis.description:
Specify a custom timeout in milliseconds. If < 0 or not set, no timeout will be applied and only the maxRetries
will be applied.

minSleepMillis.description: The minimum sleep time guaranteed each iteration.

retryOnEmptyResult.description: If set to true, it will retry when result is empty.

jitter.description: Determines the algorithm used to calculate jitter. See {@link ExponentialBackoff.Jitter}.

exp.description: exponent to apply for exponential backoff between retry attempts. Default is 2

trace.description:
If true, the retry logic will report the each retry attempt in root `C3.action()`'s `#customContext` with key as
`retry-trace`.

lastSleepMillis.description: the sleep time in milliseconds before the last retry attempt

expBackoffInstance.description: An {@see ExponentialBackoff} instance with the exp value provided above.

shouldRetry.description: Indicate weather or not action should be retried. Typically invoked by #onError and #onSuccess callbacks.

lastException.description: The exception encountered in the last call to the action.

lastRes.description: Result of the last call to the action

lastAttempt.description: The last retry attempt. If the action has only been called the initial time, this will be 0.

startTime.description: start time of the initial attempt

doNotFailOnTimeout.description: Fail if waits times out or maximum number of retries exhausted. Set by #withWaitSpec

name: Retry
